kodak_tri_x_400.author: 35mm Love
kodak_tri_x_400.observed: KODAK 400TX; 29/30 on both edges; smaller 29A/30A with an underlined right arrow below. No barcode visible in selected strip. Round-corner rectangular perforations.
kodak_tri_x_400.additional: Laura Rivera, Unsplash, 2022-05-21: https://unsplash.com/photos/a-close-up-of-a-film-strip-with-the-words-kodak-on-it-AFK0iSl-VtE . Actual close-up confirms KODAK 400TX and upper holes, but not complete lower rail. West End Cameras negative strip independently confirms 10/10A and same layout.

kodak_tmax_100.author: sruddy (Steve Ruddy), Photrio
kodak_tmax_100.observed: KODAK 100TMX; upper 23/24/25/26; lower 23/23A/24/24A/25/25A/26, with underlined arrow-like mark beneath A number. Two rows of rounded rectangular holes. No barcode visible in this reference.
kodak_tmax_100.additional: Pablo Mavricich, Troncos, 2018-12-14: https://www.flickr.com/photos/136667433%40N05/45593048504/ . Actual image https://live.staticflickr.com/4807/45593048504_a281df5639_c.jpg has 03/03A/04/04A, triangular arrows, partial 0TMX/TMX and 321-002 followed by solid square. Different specimen, not combined with 2022 layout.

ilford_hp5_plus_400.author: Kari Otteburn, Photography Stack Exchange
ilford_hp5_plus_400.observed: ILFORD HP5 PLUS above upper holes; lower 24, triangle+24A, 25, triangle+25A, 26 with interspersed two-height black bar patterns. Rounded rectangular holes, approx eight per image. No upper frame numbers in this sample.
ilford_hp5_plus_400.additional: Manufacturer republishes real sprocket examples at https://www.ilfordphoto.com/friday-favourites-sprockets/ ; page opened, main selected source remains Kari's original negative photograph.

fujifilm_neopan_acros_100_ii.author: Original poster, r/Darkroom
fujifilm_neopan_acros_100_ii.date: Precise date not independently established; after 2019 ACROS II launch; emulsion date unknown
fujifilm_neopan_acros_100_ii.observed: FUJI 100 ACROS II; upper lot-code prefix 5529 with faint suffix omitted. Lower full numbers and solid right triangle plus A half-frame numbers. No barcode visible. Both hole rows visible, rounded rectangles.
fujifilm_neopan_acros_100_ii.additional: Gary Wright, Photrio 2020, https://www.photrio.com/forum/threads/help-diagnose-a-development-problem-please.179604/ . Existing archived acros-2020-edge.jpg and acros-2020-sheet.jpg inspected. Same FUJI 100 ACROS II layout, another faint lot prefix 4443; suffix not asserted. Not evidence for 120.

cinestill_800t.author: ixe, Lomography
cinestill_800t.observed: CINESTILL 800T above upper holes; 8020 and faint suffix elsewhere on strip (omitted from chosen crop). Lower 26, solid right triangle+26A, 27, triangle+27A. Rounded rectangular perforations, not the 5219 BH model. No visible barcode.
cinestill_800t.additional: Sprocket Rocket exposes the rails with scene imagery. Only markings and perforation architecture are referenced; normal 36x24 application gate is a declared adaptation, not this camera's gate.
